nodes.label: Fallow
nodes.rationale: Positioned as Akash/io.net for individuals rather than data centers; prepaid metering in native XLM avoids per-action signing and x402 so renters pay only for time actually used.

nodes.label: Prepaid Off-Chain Balance
nodes.rationale: One top-up funds many rents so renting requires no wallet signature; a lease auto-ends when the balance runs out so a renter can never overdraw.

nodes.label: Lease Lifecycle (Sign in, Top up, Rent, Release)
nodes.rationale: Billed once at release as elapsed/3600 x hourly rate, with the contributor paid on-chain minus a platform fee and the sandbox destroyed.

nodes.label: Ephemeral Docker Sandbox Trust Model
nodes.rationale: The boundary is a throwaway container, not an OS permission system: no host mounts, no inbound ports, cap-drop ALL, cgroup caps, destroyed at lease end. Same trade-off the whole DePIN compute sector runs on, applied at individual scale.

nodes.label: Bore Tunnel SSH Exposure
nodes.rationale: The sandbox dials out over bore instead of opening an inbound port, so the contributor's firewall stays closed; TUNNEL_MODE=local publishes SSH to 127.0.0.1 only when consumer and agent share a machine.

nodes.label: backend/ Registry and API
nodes.rationale: Express + Neon + socket.io; only money state hits the DB so heartbeats and the watchdog stay off Postgres.

nodes.label: contributor/ Daemon
nodes.rationale: Proves node ownership by signing a nonce, heartbeats, and launches the hardened sandbox as a sibling container on the host Docker daemon so nothing extra needs installing.

nodes.label: web/ Vite React SPA
nodes.rationale: Vite rather than Next.js on purpose: the wallet stack is client-only, so an SPA avoids SSR/hydration friction; ships as a static build hostable anywhere.

nodes.label: example-buyer/ Autonomous Training Agent
nodes.rationale: Headless proof that the prepaid model needs zero clicks: signs in, tops up if low, discovers, rents, runs a script, releases.

nodes.label: @fallow/shared Package
nodes.rationale: Single home for types, the WebSocket contract, and pricing helpers so money-formatting rules are defined once and imported everywhere.

nodes.label: Agentic Endpoints (/explorer, /rent/:nodeId)
nodes.rationale: GET /explorer and /leaderboard are free so an agent can survey and pick a node itself; POST /rent needs no per-rent signing, so an agent only ever burns money on compute it actually used.

nodes.label: Fallow Ledger Contract (README)
nodes.rationale: Small Soroban contract on testnet that never holds money — it moves XLM wallet to wallet and leaves a public record so a transfer can be verified without trusting the database.

nodes.label: Custodial Model Limitation
nodes.rationale: Top-ups pool at one platform address with balances as an off-chain Neon ledger; deposits are recorded by txid so a deposit cannot credit twice, and payouts without PLATFORM_PRIVATE_KEY are recorded unpaid with a null txid.

nodes.label: In-Memory Nodes and Leases
nodes.rationale: Keeps the DB quiet — heartbeats and the watchdog never write to Postgres — at the cost of a registry restart dropping live sessions (the sockets die anyway).

nodes.label: Per-Lease SSH Password
nodes.rationale: The renter's wallet address is the password on a throwaway root container — acceptable for ephemeral compute, explicitly not recommended for anything sensitive.

nodes.label: Nonce-Signed Session Token
nodes.rationale: Spending requires a token minted only after signing a login nonce, so nobody can spend someone else's balance.

nodes.label: USD Pricing to Stroops Conversion
nodes.rationale: Contributors price in USD per hour (PRICE_PER_HOUR_USD) converted at a configurable XLM_USD_PRICE so listings stay meaningful independent of XLM volatility.

nodes.label: Neon Postgres Money Store
nodes.rationale: Only wallets, topups, charges, and payouts persist; no local volume is needed for the backend container.

nodes.label: Balance Watchdog (README)
nodes.rationale: Checks every METER_INTERVAL_MS whether the balance is exhausted, so worst-case over-use is one tick — the price of billing once instead of per-tick debits.

nodes.label: Stellar Testnet Prerequisites
nodes.rationale: Native XLM funded via Friendbot means no trustline or asset opt-in step for renters or contributors.
